purpose: Append exact argument canonical byte count and measured return shape to fixed historical synthetic observation metadata without rerunning science or overwriting evidence

future_engineering_budget.claim_timing: exclusive durable create and flush/fsync before the first capture-file open
future_engineering_budget.unknown_or_failure: preserve evidence and stop this extraction intent; no silent rerun, renamed intent or budget reset

read_scope.allowed_in_future: Raw bytes of only two fixed synthetic capture documents, containing previously recorded synthetic values, solely for lexical/structural metadata extraction
read_scope.not_allowed: Scientific numeric interpretation, arrays, model computation, any other raw/private/purchased data, R12 assets, old source execution or a new producer observation
read_scope.current_delivery: No capture-file bytes read; only metadata and encoder source AST inspected

lexical_method.canonical_arguments: Locate the exact arguments object; parse container structure and sort decoded object keys; preserve scalar value token bytes and generate compact canonical JSON bytes in memory
lexical_method.argument_count: len of that exact reconstructed canonical byte sequence, accepted only after matching both old canonical SHA references
lexical_method.return_shape: count the numeric-token leaves of the actual flat values array; shape=(measured_count,), not province count
lexical_method.return_identity: hash and byte_count of the compact values array must match the fixed return identity
lexical_method.scientific_numeric_tokens: validate JSON grammar only; never convert/evaluate/normalize numeric lexemes or build scientific arrays
lexical_method.string_policy: decode object keys only as needed for sorting/duplicate detection; preserve value-string lexemes; differing canonical bytes fail instead of being repaired
lexical_method.provenance_note: Both verified old encoders use ensure_ascii=True; raw capture writer indents while canonical writer sorts keys and uses compact separators
no_numeric_repair: numeric reformatting or rounding to match a hash

planned_output.write_mode: exclusive new file in the registered LOCAL_ONLY execution root; never overwrite a capture, manifest or prior supplement

attachment_contract.old_records: unchanged; supplement is a separately pinned child evidence record
attachment_contract.existing_bridge_without_supplement: keeps two unknown fields and BLOCKED behavior
attachment_contract.future_bridge_with_verified_supplement: may fill only the two measured metadata fields, with exact historical identity and context bindings
attachment_contract.no_scientific_upgrade: even complete saved synthetic metadata is not production wage evidence or source/input/scientific acceptance

fixture_matrix.required_behavior: Sort decoded object keys while preserving value lexemes; match the fixed canonical digest
Remove structural whitespace only; preserve whitespace inside quoted strings
Handle escaped quotes, backslashes and Unicode keys without decoding numeric values
Preserve decimal/exponent/sign/negative-zero spelling; no int/float/Decimal conversion of scientific tokens
Reject duplicate decoded keys, including escaped aliases
Reject NaN/Infinity and invalid JSON literals
Reject malformed numbers, leading-zero forms and trailing junk without numeric conversion
Reject incomplete objects, arrays, escapes or strings
Require exact entry/return capture field sets, correct metadata types and expected keys
Canonical argument SHA must match entry metadata and fixed lineage SHA
Canonical values SHA and byte_count must match return metadata and the fixed 39-byte output record
Measure rank1 length from the values array itself; do not infer it from province labels; reject nested/non-number leaves
Cross-check measured shape against element_types count and only then the expected origin count
Reject wrong file hash/size, source-record swap or changed context/manifest bindings
Enforce byte/depth/token limits before exposing any output
Reject reparse/symlink ancestors, permission issues or changed file state; fixture metadata injection is not a protection rebind
Existing durable intent claim blocks all subsequent actual reads; no renewal after failure or success
Existing output blocks overwrite; preserve original records and avoid raw-token/value logging

execution_grant_template.note: Template only; actual code pin/fixture result and finite authorization are recorded separately before the single capture read
